# Jayant Goyal Studio

> Public product discovery and practical developer tools, games, and productivity workspaces by Jayant Goyal.

## Features
- Developer Tools: 99+ utilities (UUID generator, JSON formatter, Base64 encoder, hash generators, regex tester, converters, parsers, and more)
- Games: Tic Tac Toe, Connect Four, Memory Match, Wordle, Typing Speed Test, Rock Paper Scissors, Dare X
- File Manager: Cloud storage with folders, upload, download
- Messenger: Real-time messaging
- Weather: City search with 5-day forecast
- Activity Tracker: Daily activity tracking with analytics
- Calculator: Cash denomination calculator

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript
- Supabase (Auth, Database, Realtime, Storage)
- Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
